page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.p: rabilia eius in profundo. Dicit namque, & flare facit spiritum turbinis, & exaltat fluctus eius. Ascendunt usque ad cœlum, descendūt usque ad uoragines: ita ut anima eorum in malo liquefiat. Iactantur & nutant uelut ebrius, ita ut omnis sapientia eorum absorbeatur.
In hac, quanquā breui, horrendæ tempestatis in mari descriptione, tria occurrunt: Efficientes eius causæ, forma, & proximus finis.

1. Αἴτιον ζωΐον[?], erat Deus, qui solus ut conditor est totius uniuersitatis rerum, sic etiam liberrimus & omnipotens gubernator est. Ille tempestates ciere, &, cum uisum est, sedare potest. Psal. 29. Itaq; præclarum Deitatis Iesu Christi argumentum erat, cum mare & uenti ei auscultarent: Matth. 8. 27. Ac uel hinc colligere est, quid eorum opinioni deferedum sit, qui Diabolum & Lamias, pro sua libidine, grandines, tonitrua, pruinam, & alias tempestates excitare posse, putant.
2. Famulans causa fuit, Ventus ingens, Psal. 135, 7. Qui ascendere facit nubes ab extremo terræ: fulgura cum pluuia ipsa facit, qui educit uentum è thesauris suis.

page.notes: The Greek words after "1." are only partly legible in the scan; "ζωΐον" is my best reading and is marked [?]. The running head and page number are printed at the top. The catchword "Peri-" stands alone at the lower right. The printed "Chrifti" and "Iefu" have long s and are written as Christi and Iesu. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
